description.value: Il Terrazzo is a long-established Victoria landmark tucked into Waddington Alley, an old-town courtyard behind the Willie's Bakery Building on Johnson Street. The restaurant specializes in Northern Italian cuisine with a Pacific Northwest influence, served in a candlelit room with brick fireplaces. A certified sommelier program oversees a cellar of more than 1,000 wine selections, making it a notable destination for a special evening meal on a multi-day tour.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 51m; rack at 71m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Il Terrazzo's website is active and fully corroborates OSM contact details (phone 250-361-0028, address 555 Johnson Street V8W 1M2). The FAQ page provides explicit negative evidence for takeout ('we do not offer any take-out options') and explicit positive evidence for vegetarian/vegan/GF options. No mention of bike parking, water bottle refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Il Terrazzo is a legitimate, active restaurant in the heart of Victoria and could serve touring cyclists seeking a dinner destination, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website. A site visit or direct contact is needed to verify basic cyclist-friendliness before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Dinner-only operation (opens at 4 pm); no lunch service, so utility for mid-day touring stops is limited. Wheelchair-accessible tables confirmed in FAQ. Service animals permitted with government-issued certification.

Takeout.detail: FAQ states: 'All of our resources are allocated to our in-house business thus we do not offer any take-out options.'

Packed lunches.detail: No takeout of any kind offered per FAQ; in-house dining only

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: FAQ states chef makes 'an excellent vegan or vegetarian pasta upon request' (described as 'very limited options') and 'Many of our entrees can be adjusted to be gluten free'; no GF pasta or pizza but risotto available

wow_evidence: cellar of more than 1,000 wine selections

price.label: Upscale
price.signal: Northern Italian landmark, sommeliers/1100+ wines, reservations; ~$40-60pp
